notes.title: Nomori Development Update News
notes.content: [p]Hello friends of Nomori, It’s been a while! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support while we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes. Our puzzle adventure game Nomori is slowly becoming a reality, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon. [/p][p][/p][p]The world of Nomori is coming to life in exciting ways, new places to explore and more characters to meet. We hope you’ll feel a connection with them as you journey together through this enchanted world. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021641/4bd3abcd6432a34afb39ee81c05f69c4b51c8ecd.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021641/83cf532cfa078a9b270758155dafcc1afc0915f4.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]We’re also hard at work designing new levels that are both challenging and fun! We invite you to join our community discord if you are interested in helping us with playtesting and make Nomori a reality! [/p][p][/p][p]We have more updates to share, and content to show soon as we work towards our release date. While we haven't announced the exact release date yet. We are aiming to release before the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for walking this path with us and please stay tuned![/p]
